rationale: Deterministic restore, scan, build, test, YAML, JSON Schema, and diff checks produced the primary evidence.
The verified local coder was the lowest-cost capable route for a bounded independent security and correctness review of the complete staged parcel diff.
Repository content remained local and the reviewer had no filesystem-write or external-network authority.

alternatives_rejected.reason: Deterministic validation proved behavior but did not replace an independent judgment review of CI semantics and scope discipline.
The local reviewer returned PASS and every material claim was independently verified, so external data transfer and higher cost were unnecessary.

validation.evidence_ref: Exit 1 with NU1903 promoted to error
Exit 0 with direct and transitive audit enabled
No vulnerable packages across all BioStack.sln projects
PyYAML parse and exact command assertion passed
Draft 2020-12 validation with format checking passed

escalation_history: The first local review runner could not spawn the Windows RTK command shim directly; transport was corrected without invoking the model.
The second runner attempt exposed command-shell quoting incompatibility; the exact local transport was corrected and the bounded model review then completed.
